objective: Build the spatial route as a disposable, isolated feature consuming compact filtered nodes, with an accessible mirror and provable teardown. Starts only after the non-spatial release gates pass.
prohibitedChanges: Never the default view and never the only navigation
Nothing added to the initial route bundle
No ownership of canonical filters, selection, URLs, or navigation history
No texture or DOM label per project - use atlas textures and instancing
deliverables: Capped scene with instanced geometry and atlas textures
Accessible synchronized list outside the canvas
Lifecycle pausing on all required signals
WebGL context-loss recovery falling back to the grid with state intact
acceptance: At most SPATIAL-NODES nodes; tighter filtering required beyond that
Desktop p95 frame time within SPATIAL-FPS-DESKTOP; mobile within SPATIAL-FPS-MOBILE
DPR, draw calls, textures and heap within their spatial budgets
Loop pauses when offscreen, hidden, overlaid, reduced-motion, or idle 2 s
Unmounting returns incremental heap within 10 percent of baseline after GC
Context loss returns to the grid with query and filters unchanged
If any budget fails, the route is removed without changing the core product
